technical.summary: AON shows solid bullish structure with price above all key MAs and three white soldiers pattern, but weak ADX trend strength and overbought oscillators create pullback risk; moderate swing entry with caution on momentum exhaustion.

fundamental.summary: AON shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest with earnings in 49 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for a bullish thesis.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal with mixed small trades 136+ days old; market fear (40 score) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of recent news data and weak bullish sentiment (24%) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (421.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-6) create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 49 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers pattern with price above all major MAs and supertrend bullish confirmation provides solid technical structure for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (421.4), unfavourable macro environment (-6 score), weak ADX trend strength (10.52), overbought oscillators, zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 49 days create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh technical setup.

decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (421.4) and unfavourable macro conditions (-6 score) create systemic downside risk that technical patterns cannot protect against; earnings in 49 days adds event uncertainty.
